title: metadata-protocol: the protocol-object-extension-item.ts header says the artifact loader stores a code package's objectExtensions as object_extension items; it files none
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location. The #28855 dev found it (PR #28873, acceptance notes; report 6567377019) while correcting the same sentence in `@objectstack/spec`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it and the lane.
Reader: the owner of `packages/metadata-protocol`; not this spec card's file surface.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "artifact loader already stores" → only #28855 (the spec registry row comment, a different file).
reach: a reader of the module that holds the `object_extension` save, publish and restore gates, who is told code-package extensions arrive as items of this type.

## Where (on `main`)

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`, header docblock, L7–8: "`object_extension` is the type the artifact loader already stores a code package's `objectExtensions` under".

## What is true (measured for PR #28873)

A code package's `objectExtensions` are registered by the ObjectQL engine's `registerApp` as `'extend'` contributors of their target object (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` ≈L9400). The artifact loader maps the collection to `object_extension` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` L132) but files no item from it: `artifactItemSlot` finds no slot for an item that has `extend` and no `name`. Items of this type are only the stored rows the `/api/v1/meta` doors write (#28574). The same header's later sentence ("it carries `extend` and no `name`") already states why.

## Done when

The header says code-package extensions are never stored as items of this type, matching the spec registry row comment after PR #28873. Comment only.
